Rebates, Incentives & Credits

Bring Your Own Battery

Enroll Your Home Battery to Earn an Average of $180 per Summer
 

See how to earn rewards by enrolling your battery in the Smart Savers program.

ENROLL NOW
About Benefits of Enrolling Get Started Eligible Batteries Battery Installers FAQs
About
Smart Savers helps reduce strain on the electric grid by allowing us to use a small portion of your battery’s stored energy during hot summer periods of high electricity demand. Eligible residential customers in New York can earn $50 for every average kW Orange & Rockland uses from your battery when you enroll in Smart Savers.

These adjustments may occur up to 15 times between May 1 and September 30 and last no more than four hours on weekdays from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.

To be eligible, you must:


Be an Orange & Rockland residential customer.
Own an eligible home battery with a minimum capacity of 5 kWh.
Be willing to allow Orange & Rockland to use a portion of your home’s stored energy during peak demand.
BACK TO TOP 
Benefits of Enrolling
Get Incentives
Put your battery to work when electricity demand is highest and earn an average of $180 per summer, while maintaining stored energy for your own use.
Improve Grid Reliability
Energy will be withdrawn from your battery during peak demand periods to reduce stress on the grid and ensure a safe, reliable power supply.
Reduce Emissions
Using stored battery energy when electricity demand is highest can help reduce dependence on more carbon-intensive sources of power generation.
BACK TO TOP 
Get Started
Step 1: Check Eligibility
Customers can enroll any eligible home battery in the Smart Savers program. If you don’t have an eligible battery, you can purchase one from an eligible manufacturer.
Step 2: Enroll Your Battery
Each battery manufacturer has a different enrollment process. Find out how to enroll your battery on our enrollment page. You can also enroll through a participating contractor.
ENROLL NOW
Step 3: Receive Your Reward
After September 30 each year, Orange & Rockland will email a $50 virtual prepaid gift card for every kW we withdraw to the address on file. Customers who lease or finance their battery will have rewards sent directly to their battery provider.
BACK TO TOP 
Eligible Batteries
If you don’t have a home battery system, you can purchase one from an eligible manufacturer or work with a participating contractor who can help install and enroll your battery:


Tesla
FranklinWH
SolarEdge
Sol–Ark
Enphase
BACK TO TOP 
Battery Installers
The following installers have experience installing residential batteries in the Orange & Rockland service territory. If you lease or finance your battery, your installer or battery provider may receive program incentives on your behalf as part of your agreement.


Apex Energy Tek
Empire Solar
Infinity Solar
Lighthouse Solar
Powerlutions
